name: Open-source hosting platform with enterprise AI assistants

mentions.name: Open-source hosting platform with enterprise AI assistants
mentions.description: This platform hosts open source software and pairs it with enterprise-level AI assistants and support (hosting, setup assistance), positioning itself as a delivery layer between the open-source community and SaaS users. It is currently an MVP.
mentions.problem: SaaS pricing is expensive—small productivity apps cost $10–$15/month, adding up to hundreds of dollars—while open source alternatives are unusable for enterprise and non-technical users without a layer of support, hosting, and setup assistance.
mentions.audience: Enterprise and non-technical users; people currently paying for SaaS products.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a Platform That hosts Open Source software & Gives users Enterprise-Level AI Assistants & Support to challenge Saas Software (Just a MVP right now!!)
